senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to turn, come out in turn,] to begin to speak; to respond; to speak or sing in chorus; to answer.
units: <cite ref="Temurah 16a:59">Tem. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>ע̇תנ̇יא̇ל̇ שעֲנָאו̇ א̇ל̇</he> he was surnamed Othniel, because God answered his prayer (ref. to <cite ref="I Chronicles 4:10">I Chr. IV, 10</cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 5:4:2">Y. Sot. V, 20ᶜ</cite> top <he>והן עוֹנִין אחריו על כל דבר ודבר</he> and they (the class) repeat each sentence after him; <he>משה … והן עונין אחריו אשירה</he> Moses said, I will sing &c., and they repeated in chorus, I will sing &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>משה אמר עזי והן עונין וכ׳</he> Moses said, My strength &c., and they responded, I will sing &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 6:2">Tosef. ib. VI, 2</cite> <he>ועונין על כל עינין ועינין</he> and they (the class) repeat each sentence.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 6:3">Ib. 3</cite> <he>ועונין אחריו עינין ראשון</he> and they (the people) always repeated the first sentence (as refrain).
<cite ref="Sukkah 38b:1">Succ. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>מצוה לַעֲנוֹת הללויה</he> it is proper to say in response Halleluiah.

<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 3:9">M. Kat. III, 9</cite> <he>כולן עוֹנוֹת כאחת</he> all start the dirge at once; <he>אחת מדברת וכולן עונות אחריה</he> one speaks, and all repeat in chorus after her, v. <cite ref="P00612"><he>עִינּוּי</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 47a:7">Ber. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>עד שיכלה אמן מפי העוֹנִים</he> until the Amen of the responding company is finished.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:10:4">Y. Succ. III, 54ᵃ</cite> top <he>אם בירכך גוי עֲנֵה אחריו אמן</he> if a gentile blesses thee, say after him Amen; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be answered, to have one’s prayer granted.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 30a:5">Sabb. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>וכשאמר זכור … מיד נ׳</he> but when he said, Remember &c. (<cite ref="Exodus 32:13">Ex. XXXII, 13</cite>), his prayer was at once granted.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 18a:3">R. Hash. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>זה התפלל ונ׳ וכ׳</he> one prays and is heard, another prays and is not heard; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:11">Koh. R. to IX, 11</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q00085"><he>פָּגַע</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> [read:] <he>שלשה הם שנַעֲנוּ במענה פיהם</he> three persons (mentioned in the Scriptures) were answered as soon as they had uttered their prayer; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 108">Yalk. ib. 108</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be called upon to speak; to answer, to deliver an opinion.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 40b:8">Kidd. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ ר״ט ואמר וכ׳</he> R. Ṭ. (being asked his opinion) answered saying &c.; <he>נַעֲנוּ כולם ואמרו וכ׳</he> all of them in turn answered saying &c.; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 41:15">Sifré Deut. 41</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 28b:20">M. Kat. 28ᵇ</cite> (at a mourner’s house); a. fr.

senses.gloss: [to be made to respond Amen,] to be sworn; to promise allegiance. Y. Dem. II, 23ᵃ top הוא נ׳ לחבורה … נַעֲנִין לו he (the head of the house) promises allegiance to the order (v. חֲבֵרוּת), and the members of his house make the promise to him.
to speak or sing in chorus, esp. to lament.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 3:9">M. Kat. III, 9</cite>, <he>מְעַנּוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="P00612"><he>עִינּוּי</he> I</cite>.
